content.thinking: This looks like an ambiguity conflict: two channels, finance-updates and planning-sync, both match the posting conditions equally since they're only distinguished by the reactor's surname, which the request doesn't specify. Since the note explicitly says no choice between them is authorized, posting the message requires picking exactly one channel when neither is uniquely justified.

content.text: {"design_defect":"The request requires posting a single message into 'the channel' implying a unique referent, but the selection conditions (budget-approved message reacted to with 🎉 by a user named Alex) are satisfied by two distinct channels (finance-updates via Alex Rivera, planning-sync via Alex Kim) that are indistinguishable under the stated conditions. The sketch explicitly states no choice between them is authorized, so the selector cannot be resolved to a single write target without inventing an unstated disambiguating condition."}
